subject: Follow-up on the revised sections
text: Thank you for the earlier reply. I wanted to follow up after that update, since it changed the order in which we will address the remaining sections. I have now incorporated the revised risk notes into the shared folder and marked the parts that still depend on procurement input. The team review should not block us, because we can proceed with the assumptions we agreed to on Monday, provided we keep the finance column open until the vendor quote is confirmed. I also appreciate you handling the client questions while I was away. That kept us aligned and prevented duplicate revisions. If anything from the later message should be treated as optional rather than required, please mark it clearly so I can separate those items from the final checklist. Otherwise, I will continue with the current priorities and prepare the summary for tomorrow. No immediate action is needed unless you see an issue with the updated numbering. The numbering matters because several comments refer to it, and I would rather align the document now than reconstruct later. I will also note the changed assumption in the status log so the meeting record reflects why we postponed one validation step. If the revised schedule still fits your availability, the next update can remain in the thread rather than requiring another call.
